landing.pageTitle: My Plan — Executive Project Management & Personal Life in One Place
landing.heroBadge: Executive Management & Personal Life in one place
landing.heroH1: Plan your projects, trips and finances with executive precision — without mixing work and personal life.
landing.heroSub: Bring together smart Gantt charts, Annual Weekly Calendar, Land & Air Maps, practical AI for minutes & cards, and Group Expense Splitting in one fast, clean web app built for desktop and mobile.
landing.modesH2:
Two completely isolated worlds.
Connected only when you need them.
landing.modesSub: Switch between Professional Mode and Personal Mode in 1 click. Work projects never clutter your vacations — and whenever you want the big picture, the unified Gantt flags schedule conflicts instantly.
landing.proBadge: For teams, managers and complex projects
landing.proH3: Executive governance with modern SaaS speed
landing.proSub: Centralize deliverables, meetings, documents and business trips in a focused workspace built for clarity.
landing.proLi1: Kanban Boards & Control: track stages, owners, priorities, progress and deadlines.
landing.proLi2: Meeting Minutes & Google Meet: create meetings, record audio to generate versioned minutes and share instantly.
landing.proLi3: Duplicate-free Google Drive: sync attachments and dedicated folders in an organized document hub.
landing.proLi4: Executive Map & Business Trips: view color-coded city cards and full team travel tracking.
landing.personalBadge: For vacations, group trips and personal life
landing.personalH3: Every detail of your trip — from flights to splitting the bill
landing.personalSub: A clean, visual space to plan trips with family or friends without messy spreadsheets.
landing.personalLi1: Smart adaptive cards: dedicated fields for Flights (airline, flight #, booking code) and Road Trips (auto routes, mileage & tolls).
landing.personalLi2: Synced travel map: curved flight arcs and Google Maps driving routes with days per city.
landing.personalLi3: Split Expenses (Splitwise-style): log group costs, minimize transfers and share payment info (IBAN, PayPal, Zelle, Venmo or Pix).
landing.personalLi4: AI Trip Journey: create upbeat, share-ready Stories and PDF summaries with zero financial data exposed.
landing.conflictsH3: Never book a vacation on a critical deadline again
landing.conflictsSub: Day to day, Work and Personal stay 100% separate. Enable Unified Calendar in 1 click on the Gantt to temporarily cross-check both timelines and spot overlapping dates in red.
landing.conflictsCalloutDesc: Days where a business milestone collides with a personal trip are highlighted in red for instant rescheduling.
landing.conflictsLi1: Guaranteed isolation: sample projects (isExample) and unselected plans never pollute your conflict alerts.
landing.conflictsLi2: Direct rescheduling: drag any bar on the Gantt to resolve conflicts in seconds.
landing.p1Sub: See your week, month or entire year with razor-sharp clarity — zero overlapping bars and presentation-ready for leadership or family.
landing.p1Li1: 3 synced views: interactive Gantt, Timeline and Annual Weekly Calendar with smart non-overlapping lane packing.
landing.p1Li2: "Fit to events" toggle: automatically frames the exact window containing your events with clean padding.
landing.p1Li3: Effortless touch & click: click empty slots to create an event on that exact date and use pinch-to-zoom on mobile.
landing.p1Li4: Ultra-clean exports: download high-res PNG or Landscape PDF ready for meetings and print.
landing.p2Sub: Turn your itinerary into a living map combining international flights and road trips on one screen.
landing.p2Li1: Automatic road routes: powered by Google Maps with real mileage, drive times, stops and tolls.
landing.p2Li2: Curved flight arcs: air segments render smooth arcs with aircraft markers connecting airports and continents.
landing.p2Li3: Live summary sidebar: total days per city, monthly breakdown and transport/city filters synced with the schedule.
landing.p3H2: Artificial Intelligence That Actually Works for You
landing.p3Sub: No generic chatbot gimmicks. My Plan AI plugs straight into your workflows to save hours of typing and produce ready-to-share outputs.
landing.p3Li1: Audio → Executive Minutes: record a meeting and get structured, versioned minutes with Word/PowerPoint export.
landing.p3Li2: Screenshot, PDF or Audio → Card/Trip: drop a ticket or booking and AI extracts legs, times and confirmation codes without overwriting your notes.
landing.p3Li3: AI Trip Journey: turn your itinerary into an inspiring Wrapped-style visual card (9:16 Stories or landscape PDF) with strict privacy (zero amounts shown).
landing.p4Sub: Ditch end-of-trip spreadsheets. Settle couple, family or group trips with exact integer-cent math.
landing.p4Li1: 4 automatic split modes: split equally, by exact amounts, percentage (%) or shares, or import costs straight from calendar cards.
landing.p4Li2: Smart debt simplification: deterministic algorithm computes the minimum number of transfers to settle the whole group.
landing.p4Li3: Universal Payment Info + WhatsApp: save IBAN, Zelle, PayPal, Venmo (or Pix QR in Brazil) and share invite links so anyone can log expenses on mobile.
landing.p5Sub: From packing checklists to executive meeting links, everything works together seamlessly.
landing.p5Li1: Kanban boards with automation: tick a card's checkbox to move it automatically to your completed column.
landing.p5Li2: Global Checklist: view every checklist item across all cards, drag to prioritize or promote any item into a full card in 1 click.
landing.p5Li3: Google & WhatsApp ecosystem: instant Google Meet links, Google Wallet passes, Google Drive sync, Google Places autocomplete and clean WhatsApp sharing.
landing.customH2: Tailored to your workflow — on ultrawide monitors or in your pocket
landing.customSub: Every visual detail, layout choice and shortcut adapts to your style and screen size.
landing.c1Desc: Pick curated palettes or custom accents, switch between Compact and Comfortable density and rename the workspace.
landing.c2Desc: Upload your logo (PNG, SVG or JPG) or search online — apply per project or per mode, updating the browser tab icon automatically.
landing.c3Desc: Switch between left sidebar, right sidebar or top bar, enable auto-collapse on wide charts and reorder or hide any tab.
landing.c4Desc: Clean top header with instant search, Command Palette (Ctrl+K), filter bottom-sheet, tap-to-create and pinch zoom.
landing.ctaBadge: ✨ Full hands-on experience with zero setup
landing.ctaH2: Open now and explore the ready-made Europe Vacation 2027 sample
landing.ctaSub: Your account starts with a complete interactive trip (flights, road legs, map, checklist and group expense split) isolated and freely editable — plus Professional Mode ready for real projects.
landing.ctaBtn: Create My Account / Open My Plan
landing.ctaFoot: 100% Web & Installable PWA · Light and Dark modes available inside the app
